description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hathigammana, Nikaweratiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 421211 (23/0928)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific declarations about land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and legal encumbrances for three distinct land plots in Hathigammana. The content focuses entirely on land administration, property rights, and title settlement processes, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
